name: BANANAS-001 | 64 Seed Reactor
loop: particular -> 8 non-authoritative constellations -> human selects one pilot -> independent owner proof -> held receipt -> optional porch return

cards.name: Orchard Cinema
cards.question: Can a single permitted motif become an editable manga panel and a reversible film candidate?
cards.smallestProof: One source-permitted Story DNA motif -> editable lemonPRESS panel -> reversible shot candidate; no publication.
cards.returns: An editable panel, a proposed shot and a separately reviewable source/choice receipt.
gates: Obtain exact permitted source and rights.
Keep the source observation distinct from imagined connective narrative.
Human panel KEEP/REFUSE before any publishing.

cards.name: Fossil Jukebox
cards.question: Can one song become an inspectable ancestry tree with competing interpretations?
cards.smallestProof: One owner-provided song identity, an alternate or album placement, and an explicitly refused false ancestry edge.
cards.returns: A replayable song genealogy card with a rejected link and a visitor-safe listening door.
gates: Require exact owner-provided identity and permitted metadata.
Keep generations, songs, albums and editorial membership distinct.
No automatic mirroring of third-party audio or lyrics.

cards.name: Needful Porch
cards.question: Can a public visitor carry music, a need and an invitation without conflating consent?
cards.smallestProof: One non-sensitive local need/offer prototype with separate review and newsletter opt-in/out.
cards.returns: An independently reviewed help slip, optionally a private follow-up, and no automatic audience membership.
gates: No raw personal requests in a public seed feed.
Human moderation and recipient confirmation remain separate.
Email opt-in is never inferred from listening or requesting help.

cards.name: Ghost Post
cards.question: Can one exact envelope travel through different carriers and return with distinct custody observations?
cards.smallestProof: One owner-created harmless envelope across two manually controlled transports; compare receiver hashes and HOLD decisions.
cards.returns: Two non-identical transport receipts pointing to one exact source identity; no invented delivery.
gates: Only authorized carriers and opt-in peers.
An emitted packet is not receipt, delivery or acceptance.
Field success requires independent physical receivers.

cards.name: Traveling Jubilee
cards.question: Can a locally invited act of care travel with music and a printable artifact?
cards.smallestProof: Paper-first host invitation plus a consented help/gift card; explicitly no claim that an event occurred.
cards.returns: A portable host packet with roles, invitation, refusal and optional verified outcome fields.
gates: Host invitation must be actual and voluntary.
Recipient acceptance is independent of giver report.
Physical print and field attendance require their own witnesses.

cards.name: Mission Forge
cards.question: Can quarantined conversation ideas become bounded work offers without being falsely promoted?
cards.smallestProof: Compile one source-identified candidate into a bounded operator-review packet, then HOLD it without running anything.
cards.returns: A reproducible mission offer, candidate loadout and independent receiver HOLD/refusal receipt.
gates: A conversation summary is not primary provenance.
Proposal, branch selection, code execution and owner admission are independent.
No automatic PR merges or canonical seed rewrites.

cards.name: Rhythm Mutant
cards.question: Can an editable source scene produce multiple human-performed visual mutations without losing ancestry?
cards.smallestProof: One permitted panel or photo with human-recorded CUT/HOLD sequence and source-preserving alternate.
cards.returns: One original, two reversible candidate cuts and a human KEEP/COMPOST decision.
gates: Source media must be permitted and hash-pinned.
Timeline acts are user-performance events, not story facts.
Render and publication are separate human choices.

cards.name: Roomship
cards.question: Can a relationship cross between independently owned worlds without overwriting either world's continuity?
cards.smallestProof: One two-world encounter card, both local interpretations and a valid one-sided REFUSE outcome.
cards.returns: An encounter specimen with distinct histories, no global canon and a replayable alternate reading.
gates: Two world owners must separately admit the encounter.
Relationship is not identity fusion or consent.
An interpretation remains a proposed descendant, not a source event.
